In cases of emergencies such as fires involving intake fans, exhaust fans, etc., the Fire Mode function ensures continuous operation of the inverter to protect other systems, excluding hardware failures and severe malfunctions. When the Fire Mode function is activated, the inverter operates continuously at the preset frequency and direction.
흡기팬, 배기팬 등에서 화재와 같은 위급한 상황 발생 시 하드웨어 적인 고장 및 심각한 고장을 제외하고 인버터가 연속 운전하게 하여 다른 시스템을 보호하는 역할을 하는 기능으로, Fire Mode 기능 동작 시에는 설정된 주파수와 설정된 방향으로 연속 운전함

PID Error Monitoring Value
PID 에러 모니터링 값
The output ratio for the difference (error) between the reference and feedback is set. If the P-Gain is set to 50%, the output will correspond to 50% of the error value.
레퍼런스와 피드백의 차이(에러)에 대한 출력 비율 설정값. P-Gain을 50%로 설정하면 에러의 50%에 해당하는 값이 출력.

Sets the time to output the accumulated error amount. Defines the time it takes to reach 100% output when the error is 100%. If the integral time (PID I-Time) is set to 1 second, 100% output is achieved 1 second after the error is 100%. PID I-Time reduces steady-state error.
누적된 에러 양을 출력할 시간을 설정함. 에러가 100%일 때 100% 출력이 되기까지의 시간을 의미함. 적분 시간(PID I-Time)을 1초로 설정하면 에러가 100%일 때 1초 후에 100% 출력이 이루어짐. PID I-Time으로 정상 상태 오차를 줄일 수 있음.
Sets the output amount based on the rate of change of the error. If the derivative time (PID D-Time) is set to 1 ms, when the rate of change of the error is 100% per second, 1% is output every 10 ms.
에러의 변화율에 대한 출력량을 설정함. 미분 시간(PID D-Time)을 1ms로 설정하면, 1초당 에러의 변화율이 100%인 경우 10ms마다 1%씩 출력됨.
Sets the ratio added to the PID output for the set target value. Adjusting this value can achieve faster responsiveness.
설정된 목표값을 PID 출력에 더하는 비율을 설정함. 이 값을 조정하면 빠른 응답성을 얻을 수 있음.
Displays the current output value of the PID controller. It is shown with the unit, gain, and scale set in the PID group applied.
PID 제어기의 현재 출력 값을 표시함. PID 그룹에서 설정한 단위, 게인, 스케일이 적용되어 표시됨.
When PID Out Inv is set to Yes, the difference (error) between the reference and feedback is set as Feedback - Reference.
PID Out Inv를 Yes로 설정하면 레퍼런스와 피드백의 차이(에러) 값이 피드백 – 레퍼런스 값으로 설정됨.
Adjusts the magnitude of the controller output.
제어기 출력의 크기를 조정함.

Used when the output of the PID controller changes too quickly or oscillates excessively, causing instability in the entire system. Typically, small values (default is 0) are used to improve responsiveness, but larger values can be applied to enhance stability if necessary. The larger the value, the more stable the PID controller output becomes, but responsiveness may decrease.
PID 제어기의 출력이 너무 빠르게 변하거나 오실레이션이 심해 전체 시스템이 불안정할 때 사용함. 일반적으로 작은 값(초기 값은 0)을 사용해 응답성을 높이지만, 경우에 따라 큰 값을 사용해 안정성을 높일 수도 있음. 값이 커질수록 PID 제어기의 출력은 안정되나, 응답성이 떨어질 수 있음.

The Submodel defines a set meta data for the handover of documentation from the manufacturer to the operator for industrial equipment.
Each SMC describes a Document (see IEC 82045-1 and IEC 8245-2), which is associated to the particular Asset Administration Shell.
Set of document identifiers for the Document. One ID in this collection should be used as a preferred ID
Identification of the domain in which the given DocumentId is unique. The domain ID can e.g., be the name or acronym of the providing organisation.
Identification number of the Document within a given domain, e.g. the providing organisation.

Flag indicating that a DocumentId within a collection of at least two DocumentId`s is the ‘primary’ identifier for the document. This is the preferred ID of the document (commonly from the point of view of the owner of the asset). Note: can be omitted, if the ID is not primary. Note: can be omitted, if only one ID is for a Document. Contraint: only one DocumentId in a collection may be marked as primary.
Set of information for describing the classification of the Document according to ClassificationSystems. Constraint: at least one classification according to VDI 2770 shall be provided.
Unique ID of the document class within a classficationsystem. Constraint: If ClassificationSystem is set to “VDI2770:2018”, the given IDs of VDI2770:2018 shall be used

List of language-dependent names of the selected ClassID. Constraint: If ClassificationSystem is set to “VDI2770:2018” then the given names of VDI2770:2018 need be used. Constraint: languages shall match at least the language specifications of the included DocumentVersions (below).
Identification of the classification system. For classifications according VDI 2270 always set to "VDI2770:2018". Further classification systems are commonly used, such as "IEC61355-1:2008".
Information elements of individual VDI 2770 DocumentVersion entities. Note: at the time of handover, this collection shall include at least one DocumentVersion.
This property contains a list of languages used within the DocumentVersion. Each property codes one language identification according to ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-2 used in the Document.
Design that partly deviates from the previous
Denotes the focus of the document and has a referential or communicative function, which is to refer to the content, subject matter or theme of the document
List of language-dependent subtitles of the Document.
text note

List of language-dependent keywords of the Document. Note: Mutiple keywords are given as comma separated list for each language. Constraint: For each language-depended KeyWord a Title and Summary shall exist for the given language. Note: This can be intentionally a blank.
Date when the document status was set. Format is YYYY-MM-dd.

Each document version represents a point in time in the document life cycle. This status value refers to the milestones in the document life cycle. The following two values should be used for the application of this guideline: InReview (under review), Released (released)
Organiziation short name of the author of the Document.
Official name of the organization of author of the Document.
Forms a generic refers to-relationship to another document or document version. They have a loose relationship

Forms a based on-relationship to another document or document version. Typically states, that the content of the document bases on another document (e.g. specification requirements). Both have a strong relationship
Forms a translation of-relationship to another document or document version. Both have a strong relationship
Note: each DigitalFile represents the same content or Document version, but can be provided in different technical formats (PDF, PDFA, html, etc.) or by a link.

Provides a preview image of the DocumentVersion, e.g. first page, in a commonly used image format and low resolution. Note: low resolution e.g. < 512 x 512 pixels. Constraint: the MIME type needs to match the file type. Allowed file types are JPG, PNG, BMP.

addresses of the currently used IP comprise four bytes (integers between 0 and 255) which must be separated by periods. These integers identify the network and subnetworks as well as the computer itself. The IP addresses are generally only used internally. On the user interface, names in clear text are generally used instead. The assignment of names to addresses is carried out by a DNS. IP addresses for participation in the internet are assigned by the NIC's because they must be unique worldwide. The assignment takes place in certain network classes depending on the size of the company. The interpretation of the IP address is determined by network masks. Not all addresses (i.e. not all combinations of four integers 0-255) may be used. Many are reserved for special functions. Since with the boom in the use of the internet the number of available IP addresses will become insufficient, new IP protocols (IPv6) are under development. These use addresses with 16 bytes

PID Control Parameter Set
The current reference value of the PID controller is the value with the unit, gain, and scale applied as configured in the PID group.
The current feedback value of the PID controller is the value with the unit, gain, and scale applied as configured in the PID group.
The error value of the PID controller, which is the difference between the current reference and feedback values, is the value with the unit, gain, and scale applied as configured in the PID group.
The output ratio setting for the difference (error) between the reference and feedback, where setting the proportional gain value to 50% results in an output equal to 50% of the error.

The time setting for outputting the accumulated error amount, representing the time it takes to reach 100% output when the error is 100%. For example, if the integral time (PID I-Time) is set to 1 second, a 100% error will result in a 100% output after 1 second. The PID I-Time can be used to reduce the steady-state error.

The output amount based on the rate of change of the error. If the derivative time (PID D-Time) is set to 1 ms, and the error changes at a rate of 100% per second, 1% of the output is produced every 10 ms.

The PID FF-Gain (Feedforward Gain) value is a setting used in PID control to generate direct control output based on expected system input values or external signals without feedback. FF-Gain contributes to improving system response speed and enhancing control stability.
The current output value of the PID controller with the unit, gain, and scale applied as configured in the PID group.
When PID Out Inv is set to Yes, the error value, which is the difference between the reference and feedback, is calculated as Feedback – Reference.
A value that adjusts the magnitude of the controller output.

PID Out LPF (PID Out low-pass filter) is used when the PID controller output changes too rapidly or exhibits severe oscillation, causing instability in the overall system. Typically, a small value (default is 0) is used to improve responsiveness, but in some cases, a larger value may be used to enhance stability. The larger the value, the more stable the PID controller output becomes, but responsiveness may decrease.
